findings.problem: The mounting boot gate (bundle-lifecycle / roles-probe) still requires bundled.length >= 20 while the RTL extraction left 19 bundled skills; the probe prints SKILLS=19 BUNDLED=19 then FAIL and the case exits 1. Green at the pre-extraction baseline (22, ok=true). The extraction turned a required boot gate red.
findings.requiredFix: Re-baseline the probe's corpus expectation to the shipped corpus (minimally >= 19, preferably derive it from the served bundle listing or assert named fixtures), rebuild packages/mpd-qa-roles-probe/dist/index.js, and re-run bundle-lifecycle.

findings.problem: 3 tests in bun test packages fail because they build their 'pristine upstream' fixture with git show HEAD:packages/mpd-agent-teams-plugin/lib/tools.js (resp. quality-gates.js) and assert zero mpd-delta markers; d510a16 committed those markers into HEAD, so the premise is false. Pre-existing (identical files at 3d99718 where the same tests fail), but it leaves the standing Tests gate red on dev.
findings.requiredFix: Pin the pristine fixture to a revision that predates the delta commit, or embed the pristine copies as fixtures, or synthesize upstream by stripping markers from a copy the test controls; then re-run the suite.

findings.problem: Both repointed RTL cases redirect HOME to a fresh sandbox but pass no --store-dir, so `dsh plugin add` dies at the pnpm step (ERR_SQLITE_ERROR: unable to open database file) and the real pass never reaches its assertions. Not a subject defect - the same install + composed boot succeeds with --store-dir <sandbox>/pnpm-store.
findings.requiredFix: Give both cases the --store-dir <sandbox>/pnpm-store treatment bundle-lifecycle.mjs already uses.
